properties.NAME: Text
properties.TEXT: Barbie Sign: Aries Style: Sleek, sassy, and sporty - that's so me! I shop all over town to keep up with the latest and greatest fashion trends! Fun: Nothing's better than hanging out with my best friends, Chelsea and Westley. We're ALL about shopping, trying out the newest restaurants, and scoping the scene for cuties! Plus I ALWAYS make time for yoga! Misc: Can't live without my iced coffees! And I'm a total gadget girl - I love everything high-tech. My 3 must-haves: cell phone, PDA, and MP3 player (packed with cool hip-hop tracks).

properties.NAME: Text
properties.TEXT: Chelsea Sign: Scorpio Style: Super fun and funky! If I can't find it at the store, I can always make it myself -- it's the best way to get the coolest fashions before anyone else! Fun: I like chillin' at an art gallery or going boy watching with Barbie and Westley -- I love to flirt! I'm totally into selling my original fashion creations at the flea market -- cool bags, belts, hats, and more! Way fun! Misc: My pup Mambo is so adorable. He loves going for walks to the flea market and to cute little boutiques. We're definitely alike in that way!

properties.NAME: Text
properties.TEXT: Westley Sign: Leo Style: Totally glam and uptown all the way! Sure, labels are cool, but if the fashion feels right, bring it on! Fun: #1 on my list is shopping! Especially when I make a day of it with my gal pals, Chelsea and Barbie. We dig getting mani's and pedi's, dancing, and grabbing coffee...nothing like it! Misc: Between shopping sprees you can catch me writing poetry and songs, going to shows, and cruising around town with my too-cool crew (sooo fun!).

DctScDataWk01A.NAME: DctScDataWk01A
DctScDataWk01A.POST_TEXT:
This week we are thrilled about frills and ruffles! 
- Make sure we have some in our sketch.
- Add funky buttons. 
- But no feather or flower trims. 
- Any colors are great, but include some plain fabric in the mix.

DctScDataWk01B.NAME: DctScDataWk01B
DctScDataWk01B.POST_TEXT:
Hi! We're doing a fall fashion collection. 
- All the designs should have big boots.
- Then add some fall colors - browns are always smart.
- No flower stamps - much too summery. 
- Some fab buttons or zippers would be perfect!

DctScDataWk02A.NAME: DctScDataWk02A
DctScDataWk02A.POST_TEXT:
It's getting cold on the fashion front, so...
- Put together something with long sleeves.
- Fabrics in any color, but no stripes.
- Add buttons for a finishing touch. 
- Save the sun stamps for some other time.

DctScDataWk02B.NAME: DctScDataWk02B
DctScDataWk02B.POST_TEXT:
Hi girls - Please do something for our new winter line.
- Definitely pants, not skirts. 
- Use some denim to make it trendy.
- A couple of zippers would be fab, dear. 
- And please, no fruit stamps - so wrong!

DctScDataWk04A.NAME: DctScDataWk04A
DctScDataWk04A.POST_TEXT:
Hi girls - we need something fresh! 
- We want long skirts. 
- You've got plenty of fabric, so use some wild patterns.
- Buttons are a must. 
- And stay away from any orange trims!

DctScDataWk04B.NAME: DctScDataWk04B
DctScDataWk04B.POST_TEXT:
It's all about accessories this week so let's go with: 
- A sketch with a purse to match! 
- Some fruity stamps would spice it up. 
- So would red fabric. 
- But stay away from chain or bead trims.

DctScDataWk05A.NAME: DctScDataWk05A
DctScDataWk05A.POST_TEXT:
Hi there - Going for a fabulous funky look...
- With some incredible pants.
- Add any trims but flowers. 
- Fabrics are up to you as long as you use some denim. 
- Round buttons are much too boring for this look.

DctScDataWk05B.NAME: DctScDataWk05B
DctScDataWk05B.POST_TEXT:
Hi - We need something for our evening-wear collection.
- Pick a sketch for an evening dress.
- Add sparkly jewel stamps to make it glam. 
- And I'd LOVE some dangly trims. 
- No brown fabrics, not the look at all!

DctScDataWk07A.NAME: DctScDataWk07A
DctScDataWk07A.POST_TEXT:
This collection is about being girly!
- So let's stick with a sweet skirt. 
- Choose pretty colored fabrics - no browns. 
- Flowers are great, but not for trims this week. 
- Butterflies would really make this perfect.

DctScDataWk07B.NAME: DctScDataWk07B
DctScDataWk07B.POST_TEXT:
Help please!  Need a hip new design for our funky street-wear! 
- Nothing too fancy, must be super sassy! 
- Choose any fabrics - I trust your taste. 
- Don't use any gems or sun stamps. 
- Zippers would be a good call. 
- But tassles would be so wrong!

DctScDataWk08A.NAME: DctScDataWk08A
DctScDataWk08A.POST_TEXT:
Hi doll, we need something for our summer collection.
- Choose a sketch with a pretty dress to impress.
- Keep the colors plain or with flower prints. 
- Add some gem or flower stamps. 
- But please no buckles!

DctScDataWk08B.NAME: DctScDataWk08B
DctScDataWk08B.POST_TEXT:
Hi dear -  Looking for something totally hot for summer! 
- Skirts should definitely be short. 
- Add sizzle with fabric colors like red and orange. 
- No blue or purple fasteners this time of year. 
- Some sun stamps would really heat things up!

DctScDataWk10A.NAME: DctScDataWk10A
DctScDataWk10A.POST_TEXT:
Hi girls.  Please work your magic on this design!  
- This week it's all about choosing designs with fabulous faux fur. 
- Fabrics are wild, include some animal prints. 
- Add some feathers to make it even more fun.
- And any stamps except flowers.

DctScDataWk10B.NAME: DctScDataWk10B
DctScDataWk10B.POST_TEXT:
This week your design should use lots and lots of layers! 
- Find the perfect design for this. 
- Then use pretty patterned fabrics. 
- Please dear, no butterflies for stamps. 
- But make it oh-so fun with feathers!

DctScDataWk11A.NAME: DctScDataWk11A
DctScDataWk11A.POST_TEXT:
We're doing a line of jackets and need an extra design. 
- Pick a sketch to fit this look. 
- The jacket should definitely be brown. 
- The rest of the outfit can have any fabric you choose.
- Dazzle everyone by adding a few gems. 
- Then add a zipper or two.

DctScDataWk11B.NAME: DctScDataWk11B
DctScDataWk11B.POST_TEXT:
This look is about dressing to impress! 
- So keep the design clean and smart - nothing scruffy or furry.
- No dangles, keep all the trims simple.
- Zippers would be terribly wrong. 
- Choose any fabric you like. 
- But avoid all stamps.

DctFdWeek01.NAME: DctFdWeek01
FORMS: What kind of food does Chelsea like?
She's got a bit of a sweet tooth.
What are the food no-no's for Barbie?
I try not to eat too much junk food.
What are this week's best picks at the Village Depot?
The green salad is really fresh and the strawberries are a fave with girls!
What do you look for in snack food?
A good snack food can be eaten without a fork!
Whose hungry mouths do we need to feed?
All Chelsea's best girl friends - oh and of course Bryant and Hudson invited themselves.

DctFdWeek05.NAME: DctFdWeek05
FORMS: What food will get you across the finish line?
Anything sweet will give you an extra boost.
What makes good meals on wheels?
Make sure it's got a wrapper since you've gotta carry it for the entire race!
If these snacks were people what would they be like?
Cookies - fun,  Candy - speedy, Muffins - dreamy
What flavours do these girls dream about?
They all love chocolate, but Westley can't eat nuts.
The cookies are yummy, but only if you eat 'em right out of the oven!

DctFdWeek06.NAME: DctFdWeek06
FORMS: Chelsea is bringing ice cream sandwiches, and Barbie just ordered some pizza.
What type of food works best for a game night?
Something you can put in a bowl to share with friends.
What tips did your dad give?
No greasy foods on the new couch - he's such a fuss sometimes!
Something that's both smooth and crunchy.

DctFdWeek08.NAME: DctFdWeek08
FORMS: Italy - she loves Italian ice cream and pizza.
Why have food at a jewellery party?
The more full the guests are, the more they spend!
Someone is baking cookies, so dessert is already covered.
Westley says, "Yuck, nothing that could drip!" And Barbie, "Maybe something with a few green and red veggies."
The ice cream will melt before you get it home!

DctFdWeek09.NAME: DctFdWeek09
FORMS: What are you in the mood for?
Something with a bit of chocolate would be awesome!
What type of food does Chelsea give the biggest round of applause?
She loves snacks that you can break in half to share with friends.
What type of food would Barbie boo off stage?
Junk food - she loves the fresh stuff, home made or farm grown.
What's it worth? Anything on sale or priced sky-high?
Strawberries just went out of season.
I just got my nails done, so nothing coated in chocolate.

DctFdWeek12.NAME: DctFdWeek12
FORMS: We take off so early! So this will have to give us energy and goodness.
Are you having a big breakfast?
We'll probably just grab some cereal bars and snack on stuff at the airport.
What does Barbie like to drink?
She prefers something on the healthy-side.
She likes her coffee drinks sometimes - but only if she's had a big breakfast.
We'll drink it in my dad's car on the way to the airport, so it's got to have a lid and straw.

DctGtWeek01.NAME: DctGtWeek01
FORMS: What has she been hinting at lately?
She wants something she can use a lot, but nothing she can make herself.
What does she do for fun?
She's very creative - always sewing new purses and stuff.
Where can you find her during the weekend?
Check out the cafe where she likes to sketch, or the flower market - she loves fresh flowers.
What are her mom and dad getting her?
Some new pens and sketchbooks for drawing her latest handbag designs.
She likes natural colors - blue like the sky and brown like the earth - but not together.

DctGtWeek02.NAME: DctGtWeek02
FORMS: She's into perfumes and the smell of new leather.
She loves getting new stuff to wear, but I'm not sure what size she is.
What kind of friend is she?
She's a true blue friend that can tickle you pink!
Has she been hinting at anything lately?
Well, she does love things that come in small bottles.
Does she have a fave brand?
She loves anything that is "O" so special.

DctGtWeek03.NAME: DctGtWeek03
FORMS: Traveling to far away places or relaxing in her room.
What type of fabric does she like?
Silks and satins are her fave for fashions.
What kind of present do you want to buy her
Something fashionable that she can take to parties with her.
Hot spicy colors like red, plum and orange.

DctGtWeek06.NAME: DctGtWeek06
FORMS: What kind of things always make her feel better?
Relaxing bubble baths, Yoga and of course shopping!
A new board game, some snacks, candles, comfy clothes and the girls!
What would mean the most to her?
Something she wouldn't buy for herself...maybe a decoration for her room.
She likes bright colors like blue, white and red.
And what are her fave things?
She loves strappy sandals, purses with handles and pretty candles.

DctGtWeek08.NAME: DctGtWeek08
FORMS: What do her jewellery designs look like?
She strings together lots of colourful beads - lots of pinks, blues and oranges.
She's not into anything 70's - that means no disco balls, bellbottoms or things that bubble on their own.
She's got enough jewelry, of course. And her parents just got her a sketchbook!
What does she like to do besides make jewellery?
She loves taking pictures and sometimes writes articles for a fashion magazine.
She has a whole wall with snapshots of her friends taped to it.

DctGtWeek10.NAME: DctGtWeek10
FORMS: What does River miss most while he's on the road?
He misses his friends, family and his favourite city - New York.
What two things does he always take on tour?
His NYC baseball cap and a couple pictures of his friends in his wallet.
Would you say River is into himself?
Well, he does love to get new clothes and jewellery, but his friends come first.
Does he get anything for free when he's touring with the band?
He gets new t-shirts and jeans in every town he visits, so he doesn't need any more of those.
What did you get him before he left on tour?
A picture frame to put pictures of his friends in.

DctWdDataWk01.NAME: DctWdDataWk01
DctWdDataWk01.POST_TEXT:
Pair up trendy patterned tops with sassy denim bottoms. 

Be sure to make the window sparkle with some gems to set off this glam style.

DctWdDataWk02A.NAME: DctWdDataWk02A
DctWdDataWk02A.POST_TEXT:
The leaves are changing - time for fall fashions! 
Choose tops and bottoms in this season's autumn colors: brown, tan, cream and burgundy. 
Give the window that autumn feeling by adding leaves. 

             Thanks girls!

DctWdDataWk02B.NAME: DctWdDataWk02B
DctWdDataWk02B.POST_TEXT:
Skirt length is below the knee this season. 
Pair longer skirts with long sleeve tops - it's THE perfect look for a date! 
Make the window a winter wonderland!

        Thanks again!

DctWdDataWk03A.NAME: DctWdDataWk03A
DctWdDataWk03A.POST_TEXT:
We need lovely looks for those romantic Valentine's dates! 
Tops and bottoms should all be red, purple or pink. 
Don't forget - add plenty of Valentine's day decorations!

            Thanks!

DctWdDataWk03B.NAME: DctWdDataWk03B
DctWdDataWk03B.POST_TEXT:
It's cold outside, but your fashions should still look hot! 
Display the latest trends in coats and long pants. 
Add final touches to the window with lots of winter decorations. 

              Thanks girls!

DctWdDataWk05A.NAME: DctWdDataWk05A
DctWdDataWk05A.POST_TEXT:
Time to get in shape with new workout wear! 
Showcase different workout bottoms and pair with cute tank tops.
Add the latest sporty toys and gear too.

                Thank you!

DctWdDataWk05B.NAME: DctWdDataWk05B
DctWdDataWk05B.POST_TEXT:
We're having a BIG sale on winter fashions! 
Display any long sleeve tops, jackets, vests and long pants.
Put up balloons and the "SALE" sign to get people's attention.

                Thanks again!

DctWdDataWk06A.NAME: DctWdDataWk06A
DctWdDataWk06A.POST_TEXT:
It's warm during the day but chilly at night!  The fashion solution? 
Pair the mini skirts with warm coats and jackets. 
Go with a day and night theme for the decorations. Perfection! 

                    Thank you!

DctWdDataWk06B.NAME: DctWdDataWk06B
DctWdDataWk06B.POST_TEXT:
Spring is in the air, so let's showoff new floral prints and fashions! 
Choose flowery bottoms and match them with a solid or floral print top. 
Make the window extra adorable with more colorful flowers. 

                Thanks again!

DctWdDataWk08A.NAME: DctWdDataWk08A
DctWdDataWk08A.POST_TEXT:
It's party time! 
Celebrate by putting festive party skirts and cute tank tops in the window. 
For extra fun, decorate with orange trims and other party items.

           Thanks girls!

DctWdDataWk08B.NAME: DctWdDataWk08B
DctWdDataWk08B.POST_TEXT:
Belts are on sale this week!  They're all the rage - showing up on shorts, skirts and even pants!
Pair them with your favorite tank tops. 
Be sure to put the "SALE" sign in the window!

            Thanks again!

DctWdDataWk09A.NAME: DctWdDataWk09A
DctWdDataWk09A.POST_TEXT:
Go wild with anything animal!  Animal prints and faux fur - find tops that show off this wild look! 
Just remember animal inspired tops go best with plain bottoms.
Be sure to add fun animal decorations too!

                   Thank you!

DctWdDataWk09B.NAME: DctWdDataWk09B
DctWdDataWk09B.POST_TEXT:
Summer's almost here! 
Warm weather calls for tank tops and mini skirts - so adorable. 
Give the window some summer flair with fun fruity decorations!

                   Thanks again!

DctWdDataWk11A.NAME: DctWdDataWk11A
DctWdDataWk11A.POST_TEXT:
It's vacation time - off to an island paradise! 
We need to display cute shorts and tank tops. 
Give this week's window a wonderful tropical feel!

                           Thanks girls!

DctWdDataWk11B.NAME: DctWdDataWk11B
DctWdDataWk11B.POST_TEXT:
Got the blues? Perfect, because that's the latest look!
Choose tops and bottoms that are mainly blue. 
Then fill the window with all kinds of blue decorations. I'll love it!

                    Thanks again!

DctWdDataWk12A.NAME: DctWdDataWk12A
DctWdDataWk12A.POST_TEXT:
Time to get trendy! 
Pair patterned tops with sassy denim bottoms.
Add glam gems to the window for that extra sparkly touch.

                        Thanks girls!

DctWdDataWk12B.NAME: DctWdDataWk12B
DctWdDataWk12B.POST_TEXT:
This week it's all about mixing it up - with festive patterns! 
Match patterned tops with patterned bottoms.
Then mix up the decorations - use any you like!

                             Thanks!

DctScrapbookDataWk01.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk01
FORMS: Chelsea was totally stoked about her surprise party!
She loved the vase we got her.
Nolee came over and read our cards...
...and said Westley would meet a guy that wasn't her usual type!

DctScrapbookDataWk02.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk02
FORMS: Chelsea looked pretty as a picture.
The guy Barbie liked wasn't at the party - she was kinda bummed.
Westley bumped into an old friend of hers whose dad is a movie director...
...and she introduced her to this artist guy - what a hottie!

DctScrapbookDataWk03.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk03
FORMS: Westley looked so cute in her new coat and teeny skirt!
That guy Barbie likes was at the party...he gave her his number!
Bella loved the gift we gave her!
The party was a total blast - we even saw a famous 'Friend' from our fave tv show!

DctScrapbookDataWk04.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk04
FORMS: We got this great shot of Barbie as she stepped through the door.
Hudson was soo funny...it was a real tribe night out!
Bryant talked Westleys' ear off all night - about Nolee!
Chelsea got a text message from that cutie she met - she was so happy!

DctScrapbookDataWk05.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk05
FORMS: We were so excited about the charity skate!
Nolee nearly got disqualified for using a skateboard!
Glad we got the shades - it was a perfect sunny day.
It turned out to be a total tribe day out!

DctScrapbookDataWk06.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk06
FORMS: Westley was so glad she got that outfit - we loved it!
Barbie was a bit bummed out about that guy - 'til she saw the chocolate pretzels...
We totally lost track of time.

DctScrapbookDataWk07.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk07
FORMS: The outfit Barbie wore for the DJ event was sooo cute!
Hudson introduced Westley to one of the DJ's - there were definitely sparks!
Barbie was interviewed by this cute guy who writes for a cool style magazine.
Chelsea saw a girl who used to live in her building - she makes the coolest jewellery!

DctScrapbookDataWk08.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk08
FORMS: Chels got yummy snacks for the special event! The pizza was awesome!
Nolee came over and bought a really cool necklace...
...and Barbie bought something for her Mom's birthday.
Chels tried on just about everything with her cool new outfit!

DctScrapbookDataWk09.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk09
FORMS: We took this photo of Westley in her awesome new outfit...
...the DJ we met a couple of weeks ago noticed too!
We got all the way backstage thanks to River's friend...
...we think Barbie has a crush on him!

DctScrapbookDataWk10.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk10
FORMS: River loved his dog tags and wore 'em on stage.
We had so much fun dancing to the band!
The bass player dedicated a song to Barbie!
But then we saw him giving his number to another girl!

DctScrapbookDataWk11.NAME: DctScrapbookDataWk11
